features.name: Warehouse Configuration Toggles and Drop-Downs
features.description: Location cards now have limited toggles for purchase, sales, service, and transfer operations, while internal operations like production, assembly, and jobs have full drop-down configuration options with various combinations.
caveats: Only applies to specific operation types

features.name: Put-Away Templates for Bin Assignment
features.description: Put-away templates are now available for assigning bins where items should be located, offering alternatives to default bin configuration with different matching strategies.
caveats: Previously available functionality expanded

features.name: Bin Policy Features for Basic Warehouse
features.description: Special equipment, bin capacity policy, warehouse class, put-away templates, and bin ranking are now available to basic warehouse configurations, not just directed pick and put-away.
caveats: Some features added in previous release

features.name: Over Received Quantity in Inventory Put-Away
features.description: Over received quantity is now available in the inventory put-away document in addition to the house receives before, removing quantity restrictions.
caveats: Document-specific availability

features.name: Picking by Ranking in Inventory Picks
features.description: Inventory picks now support picking by bin ranking, ordering pick lines according to configured bin ranking instead of treating all bins equally.
caveats: Works with both warehouse and inventory picks
Requires bin ranking configuration

features.name: Show Details in Basic Warehouse
features.description: A show details client feature allows navigation directly to the card, and the always create pick client option is now available even for basic warehouse configurations.
caveats: Limited to basic warehouse scenarios
Always create pick may result in empty bins

features.name: Nothing to Handle Error Summary Report
features.description: Enhanced troubleshooting for nothing to handle errors in directed pick and put-away mode with a short summary toggle showing pickable quantity, blocked bins, and outstanding items.
caveats: Only for directed put away and pick mode
Shows bin content and blocking status

features.name: Pickable Quantity Analysis
features.description: System now clearly identifies pickable quantity versus total warehouse quantity, distinguishing between dedicated, blocked, and outstanding items in receive bins.
caveats: Specific to directed pick configuration
Requires understanding of bin status flags

features.name: Bin availability status troubleshooting
features.description: A troubleshooting window shows detailed bin information including dedicated and blocked status, allowing users to understand why bins are unavailable for picking and identify required actions like processing put-away documents.

features.name: Item tracking integration in pick details
features.description: When items with item tracking are in pickable bins, the system displays tracking information including serial numbers and blocked field status, helping users understand why items cannot be picked.
caveats: items with blocked serial numbers cannot be picked

features.name: Reservation impact on pick quantity adjustment
features.description: The system calculates pickable quantity by comparing shipable items in warehouse against reserved quantities, reducing available pick quantity when reserved items have priority. This prevents non-reserved orders from consuming items needed for reserved orders.
caveats: calculation is complex and may be difficult to understand without explanation
delta is determined by subtracting reserved quantities from shipable quantities

features.name: Shipable quantity calculation logic
features.description: Shipable quantity includes all warehouse inventory except shipment bins and dedicated bins. The system calculates delta between shipable quantity and reservations to determine how much can be allocated to non-reserved orders.
caveats: does not include items in shipment bins or dedicated bins
requires understanding of reservation mechanics

features.name: Reservation override options
features.description: Users can either reserve the sales order to gain priority equal to existing reservations, or cancel reservations if they decide to purchase additional inventory later, enabling them to pick inventory for non-reserved orders.
caveats: requires user decision on business logic

features.name: Flexible warehouse configuration without directed pick
features.description: Customers can implement warehouse capabilities incrementally for specific departments without using directed pick, and can mix different policies like shipping and inventory picks in combination.
caveats: directed pick still available as option

features.name: Advanced warehouse capabilities with basic pick
features.description: Even basic warehouse processes can use advanced features including put-away templates, picking by ranking, and conditional line creation in pick and put-away documents, giving employees control to solve problems themselves.

features.name: Overreceive support in basic and directed warehouses
features.description: Both inventory put-away and directed put-away support receiving more than ordered, with options for direct update of purchase document or warehouse receipt, providing flexibility without impacting process choice decisions.

features.name: Nothing-to-handle troubleshooting window
features.description: A specialized troubleshooting window for directed put-away and pick warehouses provides detailed insights when problems occur, reducing time spent analyzing why inventory cannot be moved.
caveats: specific to directed put-away and pick warehouses
